# MicroDuck Live Stream Notebook Learning Line

Here, the topic is divided into 7 notebooks, each following a same path that can be explained and evaluated:

1. Understand the task and the input-output contract of the actor;
2. Export ONNX using the existing training interface, and check observation normalization, action order, and action clip;
3. Perform a numerical smoke test with ONNX Runtime locally;
4. Show the MuJoCo replay using short videos or key frames, and start web interaction if necessary;
5. Probe the RDK X5 tool via SSH, and verify the BPU inference after enabling HBM and board-side commands.

## Notebook List

| Notebook | Main Line |
| :-- | :-- |
| `01_篮球平衡_PPO_ONNX_BPU_MuJoCo.ipynb` | Speed command, ball scene, PPO, policy export |
| `02_浏览器物理扰动_回放与接口.ipynb` | MuJoCo status, external force perturbation, web playback |
| `03_高跷行走_课程与ONNX_BPU.ipynb` | BAM, shape course, motion smoothing, deployment contract |
| `04_摆动旋转_ONNX_BPU_MuJoCo.ipynb` | Swing task and built-in ONNX examples for the warehouse |
| `05_球平衡_FastSAC_ONNX_BPU.ipynb` | FastSAC and counterpart task interfaces |
| `06_梯面攀爬_接触与部署模板.ipynb` | Contact, landing target, course, and unfinished item boundaries |
| `07_RDK网页与多策略_BPU验收.ipynb` | RDK TCP, multi-policy switching, BPU acceptance |

## Startup

```powershell
cd 02-可运行代码\microduck-playground-stilts
uv sync
uv run --with jupyter jupyter lab ..\..\03-Notebook
```

It can also be started from the topic root directory; Notebook will automatically look up `02-可运行代码` upwards. If the working directory is not a topic list, set `MICRODUCK_TOPIC_ROOT`.

## Model and BPU Injection

Notebook does not have a built-in large checkpoint. Use the policy you train or download yourself:

```powershell
$env:MICRODUCK_ONNX = "C:\models\microduck_policy.onnx"
$env:RDK_HOST = "192.168.8.128"
$env:RDK_BPU_HBM = "/home/sunrise/models/microduck_policy.hbm"
```

The currently confirmed development board is `sunrise@192.168.8.128`: Ubuntu 22.04.5, aarch64, BPU Platform 1.3.6, HBRT 3.15.55.0. There are `hrt_model_exec`, `hrt_bin_dump`, `hobot_dnn`, and `/dev/bpu` on the board. There is no `hb_mapper`: the ordinary `.onnx` cannot be directly assigned to BPU; the compilation from ONNX to HBM requires a separate compilation environment matching X5 SDK. When `RDK_BPU_HBM` is not set, the Notebook will run the verified X5 MobileNet BPU sample on the board; after setting it, float32 zero-observations of `[1,61]` are uploaded and `hrt_model_exec infer` is called. Only when the exit code is 0 is `PASS-rdk-bpu` marked.

The original RDK server in the current repository uses `CPUExecutionProvider`. Therefore, the Notebook will separate the CPU results and BPU results. Do not directly rename the existing `.onnx` file on the board to `.hbm`; the HBM must be actually generated, and the quantization, input layout, output shape, and post-processing should be verified.

## Display Policy

By default, live streaming displays short videos or key frames to avoid interruptions from WebAssembly, browser GPU, and OpenGL windows. For interactive demonstrations, run the web service in the task data directory; for closed loop playback, execute the corresponding MuJoCo command in the Notebook and write the output into `outputs/`. `outputs/` has been ignored, and the video will not be re-submitted to the repository.
